answer: In the oasis agent market, each trading key must lock 100 quartz tokens for 30 days. A public beacon marks epoch boundaries, and the registry admits a key only when its bond covers the whole epoch; one bond cannot back two keys or move between keys mid-epoch. Each extra fake identity therefore ties up another 100 tokens. At a 1% monthly funding rate, its marginal financing cost is 1 token per epoch, even though the bond is eventually returned.
